title: elaeoselinum asclepium
intro: Elaeoselinum asclepium, commonly known as Ferula asclepium or Ferula foetida, is a plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is a perennial herb used in traditional medicine, particularly in the Middle East and South Asia, for its purported health benefits. The plant is said to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in reducing fever, alleviating pain, and treating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Elaeoselinum asclepium include volatile oils, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
